profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at Stord
profile.summary: I love solving difficult problems and analyzing systems. I enjoy the process of taking abstract wants/needs and translating them to a solution.

positions.title: Lead Engineer
positions.description:
Epic and task planning for projects, change execution, deployment, quality gating, and production support for Middleware systems. Lead a technical team including onshore and offshore resources for implementing changes to high visibility systems key to core company function.

-Migrated multiple key applications from JBoss Fuse to Spring Boot
-Migrated applications from Kafka to Google Pub/Sub
-Deployment and monitoring of production application releases
-Data gathering, design, implementation, and monitoring of circuit breakers for system stability
-Analysis and implementation of improvements for application performance and stability

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: Working on translating requirements to actionable tasks, some architecture design work and planning, system monitoring and alerting. Heading a team working on the automated scanning and flagging of content for sensitive and/or personally identifiable data. All work focused on systems built in the cloud, with scalable, event-driven architectures.

positions.title: Technical Lead
positions.description: Small team leadership and development role in a SaaS environment. Started out Java/App Engine focused and transitioned to a Java/Spring Boot microservice architecture focused role. Worked on Java microservices built around both event-driven consumer patterns (Kafka) and RESTful APIs. Implemented systems for processing and diffing millions of records per hour along with secure REST endpoints for accessing said data. Worked with data storage technologies from MySQL to Vitess to Elasticsearch. Extensive work around API integration.

positions.title: Product Developer
positions.description: Java application development for Google Apps management tool built on Google's App Engine. Role included front-end work using GWT, NoSQL database work using Google's App Engine Datastore, and highly concurrent backend data processing. Worked on data storage optimization and fast API crawling primarily.

positions.title: Application Developer II
positions.description:
Equifax Mortgage Services. Application development and support in Java. Java work includes usage of Spring, Spring-Batch, and iBatis frameworks.

-Website redesign work using JSP, HTML, and Javascript, along with the Struts, Tiles, and JQuery frameworks. Produced Tiles template that, through xml configuration, produced tabbed page container using JQuery for the tab UI and AJAX interaction. 

-Converted application from EJB 1.x to Spring 3.0.0 using Spring Transaction management.

-Migrated multiple applications from Sun JES and GlassFish to WebSphere 8.5

-Developed and supported extensible reporting framework using Spring and Apache POI

-Supported team Maven usage: including troubleshooting badly formed POM files, issues arising from partially complete releases, and conflicting dependency management

-Provided support and troubleshooting for Jenkins configuration and usage

positions.title: IT Developer/Engineer I
positions.description: Co-developed a cross-platform Java application for use in trimming and archiving log files, then moved on to a nearly year long project for integrating several diverse planning systems into one worldwide process stream. Also worked on localization and new development efforts for a manufacturing system.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description: Research assistant to Dr. Bo Sun. Researched design and implementation of the X-Mac protocol for TinyOS 2.x, and worked on the design and implementation of a Motelab for Research and Education using Java and PHP.

positions.title: Co-op
positions.description: Computer Science Co-op. During the first term, worked on designing and implementing a web based tracking solution for Training and Operations personnel at Johnson Space Center: a strict CMMI Level 3 design model pilot project. For the second term, worked on updating old software to meet new standards and provide new features, while working on a software package for tracking and displaying sensor data from a collection of building environmental systems.

positions.title: IS Systems Operator
positions.description: Help Desk support, computer maintenance, data processing, system deployment, network and printer troubleshooting, software training, and night closing procedures. Worked with outside vendors to solve critical, performance affecting issues.
